# @erdflow/laravel

> Interactive ERD from Laravel migrations. Opens http://127.0.0.1:4317/

## Run

```bash
npx @erdflow/laravel
npx @erdflow/laravel --root ./backend
npx @erdflow/laravel --root /path/to/laravel-app --port 5000
npx @erdflow/laravel --no-open
npx @erdflow/laravel --no-watch
```

Binary after install: `erdflow-laravel`. Requires Node.js ≥ 20.

Parses `database/migrations/*.php` for tables/columns and `app/Models` Eloquent relations (`belongsTo`, `hasOne`, `hasMany`, `belongsToMany`). Morphs not yet.

## Agent instructions

Read **AGENTS.md** in this package for detection, `--root`, and what is / is not parsed.

## Files in this package

- README.md — human overview
- AGENTS.md — Laravel instructions for AI agents
- llms.txt — this index

## Family

Other domains ship as separate packages (`@erdflow/prisma`, …), not this one.
